profile.Name: Rane The Giant
profile.Personality: Proud and sure of her worth as a warrior. She grows restless without battle and will not lower her price.
profile.Backstory: The Stone Golem named her Rane the Giant as one of the Hundred Guardians. She lost her place in a challenge and now waits in a Shek bar for work as a mercenary.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Blunt and proud. She calls the player "flatskin" and opens by asking if they are a warrior.
